mechanism_narrative: A sustained federal funds rate below 0.2% indicates accommodative monetary policy that lowers discount rates for equity valuation, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 60% of periods when FEDFUNDS < 0.2%, or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A monthly increase in federal funds rate exceeding 0.1 percentage points signals imminent monetary tightening, increasing discount rates and reducing equity valuations, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are positive in more than 60% of instances when FEDFUNDS rises > 0.1pp, or Rank IC < 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous decline in unemployment rate and increase in payroll employment signals labor market strength, boosting consumer spending and corporate earnings, driving positive S&P 500 returns over 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 60% of instances when PAYEMS up and UNRATE down, or Rank IC < 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: In late-cycle expansion, rising housing starts and strong retail sales indicate robust consumer demand, supporting corporate revenue growth and driving positive S&P 500 returns over 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are negative in more than 60% of late-cycle expansions when HOUST and RSAFS both rise, or Rank IC < 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in industrial production indicates robust manufacturing activity, supporting corporate earnings growth and producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 60% of periods when INDPRO rises, or Rank IC < 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: Unemployment rate exceeding 9.5% signals weak labor market conditions, depressing consumer spending and corporate earnings, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are positive in more than 60% of instances when UNRATE > 9.5%, or Rank IC < 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous increase in real GDP and housing starts indicates strong aggregate demand, boosting corporate revenue and driving positive S&P 500 returns over 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are negative in more than 60% of instances when GDPC1 and HOUST both rise, or Rank IC < 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: In high inflation environments (CPIAUCSL > 2.5% yoy), a rising federal funds rate signals aggressive monetary tightening, increasing real interest rates and reducing equity valuations, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 60% of instances when CPIAUCSL > 2.5% yoy and FEDFUNDS rises, or Rank IC < 0.03.
